observations: A solid black silhouette of a small rounded figure sits in the lower center, one arm raised and extended flat with palm up, a tiny winged shape resting on it and short radiating lines around it.
From behind the figure's round head, eight to ten loose wavy and zigzag black lines fan outward to the right and upward against a flat saturated yellow ground that fills the entire picture area.
A small cross mark sits on the figure's chest; a scratchy black signature appears in the lower-left corner against the yellow.
reading: A black silhouette holds something small aloft; the short radiating lines around it suggest a charged or fragile moment. Loose wavy lines fan from behind the figure's head—noise, feeling, or pressure, hard to say which. The vast empty yellow field above pulls against the crowded marks at the figure's head, giving the image a suspended, unresolved quality.
